item.title: Report: Several injured in attack on tanker north of Qatar
item.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a tanker was struck by multiple projectiles in waters north of Qatar, resulting in casualties.
According to the agency, the attack occurred approximately 94 kilometers north of the Qatari city of Madinat ash Shamal.

item.title: 'Trust was shattered' | Bereaved relative calls for full Oct. 7 probe at national ceremony
item.description: Omri Shifroni, who lost family members in the massacre at Kibbutz Be’eri, speaks at national memorial ceremony and calls for a thorough investigation to uncover the truth and restore public trust.

item.title: Trump marks three years since October 7: We will NEVER forget
item.description: President Trump marks three years since the October 7 massacre, honoring the victims and survivors and vowing to always stand against terror and evil.

item.title: Charges: ISIS sympathizer targeted Minnesota mall over Jewish ownership
item.description: An 18-year-old Minnesota man allegedly pledged allegiance to ISIS and planned a mass shooting at the Mall of America because he believed it was Jewish-owned, federal charges say.

item.title: Report: Trump weighs new strikes on Iran even before midterm elections
item.description: The White House has asked the Pentagon for options to strike Iran before the midterms as Trump seeks progress in the war and lower gas prices, according to The Atlantic.

item.title: Cain, Abel, and the shepherds of Israel
item.description: A century-old debate over shepherding in the Land of Israel takes on new meaning as modern farms combine agriculture, security, and settlement in defending Jewish control of the land.

item.title: ‘For unity in the nation’: Rabbi Kalmanson recites Kaddish
item.description: Rabbi Benny Kalmanson, whose son Elhanan fell while rescuing residents of Be’eri, recited Kaddish and called for unity and mutual responsibility.

item.title: Trump: The other side is paying a very big price for what they did on October 7th, believe me
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said that he spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, marking the third anniversary of the October 7th Massacre.
"I spoke with Bibi Netanyahu and I wished him well and I wished the people of Israel well. That was a horrible day, a horrible tragedy - and the other side is paying a very big price for what they did on October 7th, believe me."

item.title: Polls: Netanyahu bloc sees unprecedented success
item.description: Channel 13 gives Netanyahu’s bloc 55 seats, while a separate Channel 14 poll gives the bloc 63 seats, with Likud leading at 31 in the latter survey.

item.title: Amb. Leiter clarifies: Neria remains in very serious condition and is not yet out of danger
item.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the United States, Yechiel Leiter, clarified that despite several encouraging signs, Neria remains in very serious condition and is not yet out of danger. Leiter noted that "the medical treatment he is receiving in the intensive care unit at Shaare Zedek Medical Center is of the highest standard." The Leiter family thanked the medical staff and the public for their prayers and support, and asked that people continue to pray for the recovery of Neria Dov ben Chana.

item.title: Hezbollah returns to areas from which IDF is expected to wthdraw
item.description: Hezbollah activity has been identified in three areas of southern Lebanon from which the IDF is expected to withdraw under the agreements with Lebanon.

item.title: Interceptor launched at false target identified near troops in southern Lebanon
item.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon.
No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

item.title: Watch live: National October 7 families memorial ceremony
item.description: Captivity survivor Eli Sharabi and actress Shani Cohen host the October 7th Families memorial ceremony at Park Hayarkon, marking three years since the massacre.

item.title: 3 years since October 7, Israel is more necessary than ever

item.title: White House on 10/7: Trump Administration remains committed to confronting terrorism
item.description:
The White House issued a statement commemorating the anniversary of the October 7th Massacre.
"The Trump Administration remains committed to confronting terrorism and bringing hostages home. America will always stand as a beacon of freedom, defending our allies and values around the world," the White House stated.

item.description: Menachem Kalmanson tearfully recalled how his brother Elhanan was shot while rescuing residents of Kibbutz Be’eri after hours of lifesaving missions.
